_doc: Khuôn Reels (docs/specs/social-reels-templates.md): Ama/Carlos đọc mẫu tiếng Anh ≤150 wpm, chừa lặng cho người xem đọc theo (repeat), IPA lấy từ kho từ lúc dựng, chữ bản địa viết tay (native-qa).

mistake.en: Dropping the H in common words

items.native: Le H se prononce, comme un petit souffle.
items.gloss_en: The H is pronounced, like a small breath.

items.native: Souffle sur le H avant de dire ouse.
items.gloss_en: Blow on the H before saying ouse.

items.native: Le H initial fait un petit souffle.
items.gloss_en: The first H makes a small breath.

items.native: Pas de « ongry » : le H est bien là.
items.gloss_en: Not ongry: the H is really there.

segments.text: Four words many people say wrong. Listen, then repeat after me.

native.hook: 4 mots où le H se prononce
native.caption: En anglais, le H se prononce : on souffle un peu d’air au début de “hotel”, “house”, “happy” et “hungry”. Écoute Carlos, puis répète chaque mot pendant le silence. Travaille la prononciation dans l’appli Lexkite.

en.hook: 4 words where the H is pronounced
en.caption: In English the H is pronounced: you push a little air out at the start of “hotel”, “house”, “happy” and “hungry”. Listen to Carlos, then say each word in the pause. Practice pronunciation in the Lexkite app.
